text.title: 最后一张桌与敞开的门
text.goal: 最后一张桌与敞开的门
text.situation:
在最后一张桌，一位访客望着铅笔尖，试着沿印好的线描画。告示称这是涉及手眼协调的活动。线突然转弯时，她笑了，又要了一张纸。萨姆指着线的拐弯处，她又试着慢一些沿线描画。

大厅变暖了。萨姆把备用椅子搬向门口时开始出汗。他擦掉额头上的汗，在敞开的门旁停了一会儿。玛雅从前台拿着访客名单过来。两人回望展台，确认最后一组访客找到出口。随后萨姆放下名单，去取一杯水。

paragraphs.en: At the last table, a visitor tried drawing along a printed line while watching the tip of a pencil. The sign called it an activity involving hand-eye coordination. She laughed when the line turned suddenly and asked for another sheet. Sam pointed to the turn in the line, and she tried following it more slowly.

paragraphs.en: The hall had become warm. Sam began to perspire as he carried the spare chairs towards the door. He wiped the perspiration from his forehead and paused beside the open doorway. Maya came from the desk with the visitor list. They looked back across the tables, checking that the last group had found the exit. Then Sam put down the list and went to fetch a cup of water.
